mainText: Hello, Verona! At 7 AM, here is today's balanced dish: the temperature is 38 degrees with clear skies near City Hall. Please note that the ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive Reconstruction Project. Phase two is currently underway, focusing on water main and sanitary sewer improvements, with new concrete sidewalks and landscaping planned to follow.

It is a busy week for entertainment. Today, you can join trivia at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, or Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday pizza and a pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.

Regarding the weekly police report, on October 25, officers located a 40-year-old man passed out behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, leading to an arrest for an O W I.
The flavor of the day at Culver's is Chocolate Heath Crunch. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop later this morning.
